name: updraft/sync@1
description: The sync of the logbook with a server, provided by the app on every page. Signing in and out stays with the user.

status.description: The current sync state. A new object on every call.

syncNow.description: Runs a sync now. Resolves when it ended, also when nothing ran because the user is not signed in or a sync just ran. Failures show in the sync panel of the app and never reject.

status.description: The status changed: signed in or out, a server was chosen or forgotten, a sync started or ended.

SyncInfo.description: The state of the sync with a server.

signedIn.description: Whether the user is signed in to a server.

url.description: Address of the chosen server, or null when none is chosen.

lastSyncAt.description: Time of the last finished sync in epoch ms, or null when none ran yet.

busy.description: Whether a sync is running right now.
